name: sign-up-01
reason: New web screen block. Its React Native port follows with sign-in-01's; signup-01 to signup-05 cover native sign-up until then.

name: forgot-password-01
reason: New web screen block. Its React Native port follows with the other auth blocks; the steps and rules are pure modules it can reuse.

name: finance-01
reason: New web dashboard block built on App Shell and the charts. Its React Native port waits for a phone layout of the KPI row, charts and tables designed for touch.

name: assistant-01
reason: New web chat block. Chat Input and Model Picker have no native versions yet (see PLATFORMS.md), so the native port waits for them.

name: messenger-01
reason: New web chat block. Chat Input has no native version yet (see PLATFORMS.md), so the native port waits for it.

name: calendar-app-01
reason: New web calendar block. Its React Native port composes the native Event Calendar and Date Picker, with Time Input still web-only (see PLATFORMS.md).

name: mail-01
reason: New web email block on App Shell. Its React Native port waits for a phone composition of the thread list, the thread sheet and the compose form; the folder, filter and selection rules are pure modules it can reuse.

name: cn-status-bar-lift-mark
reason: The website's lift fades its SVG mark in separately from the group that glides; native's lift is one Animated.View that fades itself.

name: useChartPresence
reason: The website holds the last inspected mark so its readout can fade out with CSS. Native overlays fade out on unmount through Reanimated's exiting animation (useFadeOut), so they need no held state.

name: leaving
reason: The website marks a held readout data-leaving so CSS fades it out. Native overlays unmount when the finger lifts and fade out through Reanimated's exiting animation instead.

name: cn-chart-slice-mark
reason: Only fades the 0.5px outline that closes a pie's seams when its slice dims. Native draws no outline on a dimmed slice, so there is nothing to style.
